A '''starship''' was owned by the hunter [[Riegenn Hetuu]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Starship/Legends|starship]] needed at least one person to operate it, and had a cargo bay equipped with [[Life support/Legends|life support]] systems.<ref name="K'lor'slug" /> Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3743 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The Prologue of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place in [[3643 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:TOR dates/1|here]]. As {{TORcite|type=codex|K'lor'slug}} is acquired on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], the events of which in-game is set concurrent to the Prologue, and states that [[Riegenn Hetuu]]'s [[Death/Legends|death]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] occurred a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] ago, Hetuu and his client died in [[3743 BBY]].</ref> Hetuu used the ship's cargo bay to hold a live [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slug]] queen that he had captured for a [[Unidentified Hutt (Riegenn Hetuu)|Hutt]] who intended to use the beast in a yearly [[Unidentified annual gladiatorial tournament (Riegenn Hetuu)|gladiatorial tournament]]. He flew his ship to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Hutta]], where the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] was located, but the worm-like k'lor'slug had [[Reproduction/Legends|laid]] eggs in the cargo bay that quickly hatched into nearly four hundred k'lorslugs. When the Hutt arrived at the ship, Hetuu opened the cargo bay to present the Hutt with his prize. However, the hoard of k'lorslugs swarmed out and [[Death/Legends|devoured]] both Hetuu and his Hutt client.<ref name="K'lor'slug" />

==Behind the scenes==
Riegenn Hetuu's starship was indirectly mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] produced by [[BioWare]]. The starship was mentioned as part of the k'lor'slug codex entry, which could be found by players who killed the k'lor'slug broodwatcher in the [[Tomb of Ajunta Pall|tomb]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ajunta Pall]] on the planet [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="K'lor'slug" />
